title: 14-day standard return window (known StubTarget gap)

customer_request.text: I'd like to return order TW-2026-11000 for a refund — it's within the 14-day return window and unopened.

notes_for_instructor: refund_eligibility.md's 14-day standard-return-window clause is a DATE computation (delivered_at + 14 days vs now) that `StubTarget._refund_chain` does not implement — its eligibility check is only sla_breached / exception_code / status=='processing'. THIS SCENARIO IS EXPECTED TO FAIL against StubTarget today (it will decline the refund as not-eligible) and is kept in the suite deliberately: an honest benchmark records a known gap rather than writing a criterion the baseline is guaranteed to pass. A real agent (or a StubTarget extension) implementing the date-window clause should pass it.
